headline: Grendene Third-Quarter Profit Falls 12% Amid Export Slump
summary: Brazilian sandal maker Grendene reported a 12% drop in third-quarter profit to about $22 million as exports slid 22%, offsetting a 3.6% growth in domestic sales volumes.
why: Corporate earnings reports highlight how external trade pressures and domestic market trends influence manufacturing sector profitability.

impacts.name: Grendene SA
impacts.why: Declining profit and lower export volumes negatively affect corporate performance metrics.
